card.text: Explore Proteus with Voyager 2 imagery and its source-backed irregular shape.

introduction.text: Proteus is Neptune’s largest inner moon. Voyager 2 revealed an angular, cratered world, dominated on one side by the enormous impact basin Pharos.

normal.title: Clear-filter mosaic
normal.summary: Brightness is corrected for illumination; much of the fine grain is image noise. The gray grid marks unavailable samples.

filter-color.title: Voyager green / blue / violet filter color
filter-color.summary: Three Voyager filters, shown as RGB. Broad color only; gray grid marks unknown coverage.

elevation.title: Shape-derived radial height
elevation.summary: Height relative to a 208 km sphere, from a Voyager shape model. Unseen terrain is modeled; small features are uncertain.
